Game Overview

Hunter Willie is a dinosaur title where brave the depths with Hunter Willie, navigating shadowy caves teeming with ferocious beasts. Armed with only a sporting gun, strategize each move, collect precious ammo, and battle through relentless predators. Can you guide Willie to the gleaming escape? Embark on this thrilling adventure of survival and skill.
